en-US.author: Block, Inc.
en-US.description: An open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions — install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM.
en-US.longDescription:
Goose is an open source, extensible general-purpose AI agent that runs locally. It automates engineering tasks by installing, executing, editing, and testing with any LLM.
The CLI works with 15+ providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, and Bedrock, and extends through 70+ MCP (Model Context Protocol) extensions. Goose can act as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent for editors such as Zed and JetBrains IDEs, and supports ACP agents as providers.
en-US.name: Goose
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ Features
- Minimal deferred MCP tools in ToolExecutionOperation #13378
- Configurable and per-start voice instructions for live-voice #13375
- Configurable GPT-Live endpoint, model and key #13360
- Filter session/list by client tags (ACP) #13173
- Stop, approval, and tool hook operations for goose-agent (GDK) #13169
- Resume completed delegates with a follow-up (subagent) #13106
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Honor HTTP(S) docs roots in goose-doc-guide #13381
- Use uncorrelated IN for session keyword search #13373
- Isolate session database initialization from application pool #13324
- Refresh Databricks OAuth tokens before they expire #13328
- Reword compaction prompt that Opus 5.5 refuses as distillation #13340
- Send Gemini thinking level and drop stream_options for Databricks #13232
- Address new cargo-deny advisories (zip8) #13309
📚 Documentation
- Correct SECURITY_PROMPT_THRESHOLD sensitivity direction #12954
- Blog post: Same Brain, Different Bill #13197

zh-CN.description: 一个开源、可扩展的 AI 智能体，超越代码补全——使用任何大语言模型安装、执行、编辑和测试。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Goose 是一个开源、可扩展的通用 AI 智能体，在本地运行。它通过使用任何大语言模型执行安装、执行、编辑和测试来自动完成工程任务。
该 CLI 支持 15 家以上的模型提供商，包括 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Ollama、OpenRouter、Azure 和 Bedrock，并可通过 70 多个 MCP（模型上下文协议）扩展进行扩展。Goose 可以作为面向 Zed、JetBrains IDE 等编辑器的智能体客户端协议（ACP）智能体，也支持将 ACP 智能体用作提供商。
